主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. has completed its annual filings for the month of March 2016. The filings were submitted as part of a Form 6-K report to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The company is based in Toronto, Canada, and its principal executive offices are located at Suite 300, Brookfield Place, 181 Bay Street, P.O. Box 762, Toronto, Canada M5J 2T3. The report was signed by Brian D. Lawson, the Chief Financial Officer, on March 30, 2016. The filings are part of the company's compliance with U.S. securities regulations.
